claim: Android's real DocumentsUI journey imported an H.264/AAC MP4 and an audio-only MP3 in one selection, then passed captions, relink, export, process recovery and bounded-resource checks.

verification.detail: All seven jobs passed. The Android job selected both files through DocumentsUI, then imported, captioned, relinked, exported WebM, recovered after process death, and stayed within the bounded-resource report. Desktop packaged journeys also passed.

limitations: Android evidence is from an API 36 x86_64 SwiftShader emulator, not a physical device.
The emulator logged skipped frames and a 121 ms maximum main-draw measurement under this acceptance workload; physical-device responsiveness remains unverified.
The fixture proves multi-source selection and correctness only, not representative media performance.
The prior exact-SHA run 38196732759 exposed a real SAF multi-import regression that this run verifies as repaired.
